selection_reason: It changes the inference-time decoding path for multimodal diffusion LLMs and manages runtime cost while improving visual information selection. The abstract does not claim a throughput speedup; full-text sections confirm fixed scheduling, no extra model forward pass, and near-baseline throughput.
